summary: Russian forces launched a massive overnight drone attack on 22 November 2026, striking a five-story residential building in Dymyr, Kyiv region, with 7-8 people potentially trapped under rubble. Simultaneous launches occurred from at least five Russian airbases, with reactive UAVs detected across 12 Ukrainian regions. Ukrainian air defenses engaged targets while rescue operations continue in Dymyr.
key_points: Russian strike UAV hit a five-story residential building in Dymyr, Vyshhorod district, destroying an entrance and damaging a kindergarten and store, with 7-8 people possibly under rubble (Source: @eRadarrua/132579)

Massive drone launches recorded from Orel (4 groups), Shatalovo (3 groups), Primorsko-Akhtarsk (9 groups), Guardiyskoye (5 groups), and Millerovo (3 groups) overnight (Source: @eRadarrua/132514, @eRadarrua/132585)

Reactive UAVs (Shahed/Geran-5) detected over Kyiv, Vyshhorod, Chabany, and across Chernihiv, Zhytomyr, Poltava, Dnipropetrovsk, Zaporizhzhia, Kharkiv, Mykolaiv, Kherson, Odesa, Vinnytsia, Kirovohrad, Cherkasy, Sumy regions (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78721, @kpszsu/98367, @eRadarrua/132574)
Kyiv air raid alert active 01:22-02:08 local time; UAV at 4000m altitude, 555 km/h tracked over Vyshhorod toward Troieshchyna (Source: @eRadarrua/132539, @eRadarrua/132573, @mon1tor_ua/78723)
DeepState reports Russian advances near Novomarkove and Mykolaivka on eastern front (Source: @DeepStateUA/24018)
UK and Ukraine signed agreement for joint production of middle-strike and deep-strike drones in UK, funded by Britain (Source: @UkraineNow/85454)
Slovak PM Fico rejects new €45bn EU loan for Ukraine, calls it a gift Ukraine cannot repay, will discuss at Visegrad meeting Monday (Source: @UkraineNow/85457)

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces conducted a large-scale overnight drone offensive on 22 November 2026, launching reactive UAVs from at least five airbases across western Russia. A strike hit a five-story residential building in Dymyr, Kyiv region, causing structural collapse and potential casualties with 7-8 people reported under rubble. Ukrainian air defenses engaged targets across 12 regions while rescue operations continue. Concurrently, DeepState reports Russian ground advances near Novomarkove and Mykolaivka, and geopolitical tensions rise with Slovakia rejecting EU financial aid and NATO reaffirming Article 5 commitments for Poland.

points: Ukrainian air defense units engaged reactive UAVs across 12 regions overnight, including Kyiv, Chernihiv, Zhytomyr, Poltava, Dnipropetrovsk, Zaporizhzhia, Kharkiv, Mykolaiv, Kherson, Odesa, Vinnytsia, Kirovohrad, Cherkasy, and Sumy, with multiple monitoring channels tracking Shahed/Geran-5 type drones (Source: @eRadarrua/132574, @kpszsu/98392, @kpszsu/98367).

Rescue operations ongoing in Dymyr, Vyshhorod district, after Russian UAV strike destroyed entrance of five-story residential building from first to fifth floor, damaged nearby kindergarten and store; rescuers report 7-8 people possibly under rubble as of 22 November morning (Source: @eRadarrua/132579, @UkraineNow/85458).

Ukraine and United Kingdom signed defense agreement for joint production of middle-strike and deep-strike long-range drones in UK territory, with British funding and finished drones transferred to Ukrainian forces, per Ministers Khmar and Streeting (Source: @UkraineNow/85454).

Kyiv air raid alert sounded at 01:22 and cleared at 02:08 local time; monitoring channel reported UAV at 4000m altitude and 555 km/h over Vyshhorod moving toward Troieshchyna (Source: @eRadarrua/132539, @eRadarrua/132573, @mon1tor_ua/78723).
Nationwide minute of silence observed daily at 09:00 to honor fallen Ukrainians, per eRadarrua reminder (Source: @eRadarrua/132576).

Russian forces launched reactive UAVs from at least five airbases overnight: Orel (4 groups), Shatalovo (3 groups), Primorsko-Akhtarsk (9 groups), Guardiyskoye (5 groups), and Millerovo (3 groups), per launch detection reports (Source: @eRadarrua/132514, @eRadarrua/132585).

Russian strike UAV hit civilian infrastructure in Dymyr, Kyiv region, destroying residential building entrance and damaging kindergarten and store, indicating continued targeting of populated areas (Source: @eRadarrua/132579).
Russian dry cargo vessel reported sinking near Gelendzhik in Krasnodar Krai, per UkraineNow citing local reports (Source: @UkraineNow/85445).
Russian missile violated Polish airspace, prompting NATO Secretary General Rutte to declare NATO will defend every inch of Polish territory (Source: @UkraineNow/85453).
Budanov addressed nation on Day of Dignity and Freedom, stating "Ukraine's will cannot be broken" (Source: @UkraineNow/85446).
DeepState map update 22 November shows Russian forces advanced near Novomarkove and in Mykolaivka, indicating ongoing offensive operations in Donetsk direction (Source: @DeepStateUA/24018).
Harivka region experienced 3 reactive UAVs maneuvering in Izium-Barvinkove area, per eRadarrua monitoring (Source: @eRadarrua/132520).

Kharkiv region: 5 groups of strike UAVs and 2 groups of reactive UAVs detected; additional 3 reactive UAVs near Izium, 2 passing Izium toward Kharkiv region (Source: @eRadarrua/132515, @eRadarrua/132536, @kpszsu/98390).

Dnipropetrovsk region: 2 groups of reactive UAVs plus 1 reconnaissance UAV; reactive UAVs over Pokrovske and Vyshneve; 2 reactive UAVs on Kobylyaky in Poltava region (Source: @eRadarrua/132589, @kpszsu/98369, @eRadarrua/132548).
Zaporizhzhia region: 1 group of strike UAVs and 3 groups of reactive UAVs; guided aviation bombs launched by Russian tactical aviation on Zaporizhzhia city (Source: @eRadarrua/132516, @kpszsu/98399).

Chernihiv region: multiple reactive UAVs detected from Bryansk Oblast, Russia, moving toward Chernihiv and Kyiv regions; 2 UAVs past Ichne toward Kyiv region; strike UAV group reported at Honcharivske and Ripky (Source: @kpszsu/98406, @eRadarrua/132591, @eRadarrua/132548).

Sumy region: 1 group of strike UAVs detected; reactive UAV from Sumy region toward Chernihiv region near Korop; reactive UAV toward Putyvl from north (Source: @eRadarrua/132588, @kpszsu/98389, @kpszsu/98347).

Kyiv region: reactive UAVs over Zhurivka/Yahotyn, Hrebinky, and from Chernihiv region toward Bila Tserkva; Geran-5 reported over Kyiv/Vyshhorod and Kyiv/Chabany (Source: @kpszsu/98404, @kpszsu/98402, @mon1tor_ua/78721, @mon1tor_ua/78719).
Zhytomyr region: reactive UAV from northern Kyiv region toward northern Zhytomyr region; reactive UAV group toward Korosten from north (Source: @kpszsu/98368, @eRadarrua/132572).

Poltava region: reactive UAVs toward Kremenchuk from east and northeast; toward Khorol from southeast; 2 reactive UAVs on Kobylyaky (Source: @kpszsu/98392, @kpszsu/98397, @eRadarrua/132548, @eRadarrua/132572).

Odesa region: 3 UAVs remaining near Vylkove, 1 near Tatarbunary; reactive UAV past Savran moving northwest; reactive UAV in Black Sea toward Ochakiv (Source: @eRadarrua/132538, @kpszsu/98367, @kpszsu/98387).

Mykolaiv region: reactive UAVs in southern region moving northwest; near Veselynove and Berezanka moving northwest; from Mykolaiv region toward Kirovohrad region eastward; 2 groups of reactive UAVs detected (Source: @kpszsu/98376, @kpszsu/98394, @kpszsu/98400, @eRadarrua/132523).
Kherson region: 2 groups of reactive UAVs; 1 group of reactive UAVs later (Source: @eRadarrua/132516, @eRadarrua/132589).

Kirovohrad region: reactive UAV past Haivoron toward Vinnytsia (Tepluk); reactive UAVs from Mykolaiv region westward; from Mykolaiv region northward toward eastern Kirovohrad (Source: @kpszsu/98371, @kpszsu/98380, @kpszsu/98400).
Vinnytsia region: 1 reactive guided UAV on Dashiv; 1 reactive UAV over Dnipro river (Source: @eRadarrua/132575).

Massive Russian reactive UAV (Shahed/Geran-5) launch overnight 22 November from five airbases: Orel (4 groups), Shatalovo (3 groups), Primorsko-Akhtarsk (9 groups), Guardiyskoye (5 groups), Millerovo (3 groups), totaling at least 24 launch groups (Source: @eRadarrua/132514, @eRadarrua/132585).

Kyiv air defense engagement: Geran-5 UAVs over Kyiv/Vyshhorod and Kyiv/Chabany; UAV tracked at 4000m altitude, 555 km/h over Vyshhorod toward Troieshchyna; air raid alert 01:22-02:08 (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78721, @mon1tor_ua/78719, @mon1tor_ua/78723, @eRadarrua/132539, @eRadarrua/132573).

Strike UAV hit five-story residential building in Dymyr, Vyshhorod district, Kyiv region, destroying entrance floors 1-5, causing fire, damaging kindergarten and store; 7-8 people possibly under rubble (Source: @eRadarrua/132579).
Russian tactical aviation launched guided aerial bombs on Zaporizhzhia city (Source: @kpszsu/98399).

Reactive UAVs detected across 12 Ukrainian regions simultaneously, indicating coordinated saturation attack (Source: @eRadarrua/132574, @kpszsu/98392, @kpszsu/98367, @eRadarrua/132515, @eRadarrua/132589).

sections.threat_assessment: The overnight saturation drone attack demonstrates Russia's capacity to launch complex, multi-axis UAV operations from dispersed airbases, overwhelming air defense coverage across 12 regions simultaneously. The Dymyr strike on dense residential infrastructure signals continued Russian strategy of targeting civilian areas to degrade morale. Eastern front advances near Novomarkove/Mykolaivka suggest Russian ground forces are exploiting fixation of Ukrainian reserves on air defense. The combination of mass UAV launches, guided bomb strikes on Zaporizhzhia, and ground gains indicates a coordinated escalation across domains. Ukrainian air defense saturation risks creating gaps for future missile strikes.
sections.regional_response: NATO's explicit Article 5 commitment for Poland following Russian airspace violation marks a significant deterrence reinforcement on the eastern flank. The UK-Ukraine drone production agreement provides tangible long-range capability expansion independent of US political cycles. Conversely, Slovakia's rejection of the €45bn EU loan package and Fico's rhetoric about linking aid to budget negotiations reveals growing fractures in EU unity on Ukraine funding. The Visegrad+ meeting Monday will test regional cohesion. These divergent responses create a complex diplomatic landscape where military support (UK) and security guarantees (NATO) advance while financial sustainment (EU) faces political headwinds.
sections.intelligence_notes: The use of five separate launch sites (Orel, Shatalovo, Primorsko-Akhtarsk, Guardiyskoye, Millerovo) for a single wave suggests Russian command has achieved sufficient UAV inventory and launch coordination for distributed operations, complicating pre-launch interdiction. The Geran-5's recorded 4000m altitude and 555 km/h speed over Kyiv indicates performance envelope exceeding earlier Shahed-136 variants, potentially requiring updated interceptor parameters. The simultaneous presence of strike UAVs, reactive UAVs, and reconnaissance UAVs across sectors implies integrated ISR-strike cycles. The Dnipro river crossing by a reactive UAV in Vinnytsia region demonstrates navigation capability over major water obstacles. The sinking Russian cargo ship near Gelendzhik may indicate Ukrainian naval drone or mine activity in previously secure rear areas.
